product_endpoint_policy: A product endpoint is complete only when its E_gas value is listed here or its explicit *_box.cif exists. Missing product molecules are not generated by ASE fallback.
note: ZPE, entropy, solvation, electric-field, and potential corrections are intentionally excluded from the default SAGE CO2RR workflow. CH2O_box.cif is neutral HCHO(g), not a mandatory CH2O* surface intermediate.
